FAQ

Products & B2B Questions

What fasteners do you supply?

Bolts, nuts, threaded rods and studs, anchor and foundation fasteners, expansion anchors, self-drilling and self-tapping screws, pins, rivets and retaining components, solar / PV fasteners, and custom non-standard fasteners.

Which bolt sizes are available?

Hex bolts in grade 4.8 are listed from M6 to M24, high-strength hex bolts from M8 to M30, flange bolts from M6 to M16, countersunk socket screws from M4 to M24 and tension control bolts from M16 to M24. Custom large bolts are handled in the M30 to M120 category.

Do you supply high-strength bolts?

Yes. Grades 8.8, 10.9 and 12.9 are listed for high-strength hex bolts and socket head cap screws.

Do you offer large-diameter bolts?

Yes. Custom bolts are handled in an M30 to M120 category. Length, grade, material and finish are confirmed case by case against your drawing.

Can you manufacture non-standard fasteners?

Yes. Drawing-based custom components, special geometries, oversized and extra-long parts are reviewed against your technical documentation.

Do you manufacture reverse-thread products?

Reverse-thread (left-hand) screws and trapezoidal threaded rods are part of the custom portfolio.

Do you supply solar fasteners?

Yes — PV bolts and nuts, pressure-block bolts, support brace rods, seismic support accessories, C-channel matching bolts, clamps, triangle connectors and tile hooks.

How can I request pricing?

Add products to your RFQ list and submit it, or send your product list directly through the Request Center.

Can I upload a BOM?

Yes. XLS, XLSX, CSV and PDF purchasing lists can be submitted instead of entering each item manually.

Can I send a drawing?

Yes. PDF, DWG, DXF, STEP/STP, JPG, PNG and XLSX files can be submitted with a custom fastener request.

Do you work with distributors?

Yes. Distributor and importer cooperation is handled through the distributor application.

What information should I provide for an RFQ?

Product type, diameter, length, thread, grade, material, surface treatment, standard or drawing, and quantity. Provide what you have — missing details are clarified during technical review.

Need Standard or Custom Fasteners?

Send us your product list, dimensions, quantities, BOM or technical drawing for quotation.

常见问题

产品与B2B常见问题

你们供应哪些紧固件？

螺栓、螺母、螺纹杆及螺柱、地脚与基础紧固件、膨胀锚栓、自钻及自攻螺钉、销/铆钉及挡圈组件、光伏紧固件，以及定制非标紧固件。

有哪些螺栓规格可选？

4.8级六角螺栓规格为M6至M24，高强度六角螺栓为M8至M30，法兰螺栓为M6至M16，内六角沉头螺钉为M4至M24，扭剪型高强度螺栓为M16至M24。定制大规格螺栓则在M30至M120范围内处理。

你们是否供应高强度螺栓？

是的。高强度六角螺栓及内六角圆柱头螺钉提供8.8、10.9和12.9级。

你们是否提供大直径螺栓？

是的。定制螺栓涵盖M30至M120范围，长度、强度等级、材质及表面处理将根据您的图纸逐案确认。

你们能生产非标紧固件吗？

是的。来图定制零件、特殊形状、超大规格及超长零件均可根据您的技术文件进行评审。

你们是否生产反牙（左旋）产品？

反牙（左旋）螺钉及梯形螺纹杆均属于定制产品系列。

你们是否供应光伏紧固件？

是的——包括光伏专用螺栓螺母、压块螺栓、支撑拉杆、抗震支架配件、C型钢配套螺栓、压块、三角连接件及瓦钩。

如何获取报价？

将产品添加至询价清单并提交，或通过需求中心直接发送您的产品清单。

我可以上传BOM清单吗？

是的。可提交XLS、XLSX、CSV或PDF格式的采购清单，无需逐项手动录入。

我可以发送图纸吗？

是的。可随定制紧固件需求一并提交PDF、DWG、DXF、STEP/STP、JPG、PNG及XLSX格式文件。

你们是否与经销商合作？

是的。经销商及进口商合作请通过经销商申请渠道办理。

提交询价时需要提供哪些信息？

产品类型、直径、长度、螺纹、强度等级、材质、表面处理、执行标准或图纸以及数量。请提供您已有的信息——缺失的细节将在技术评审阶段进一步确认。

需要标准件或非标定制紧固件？

请将您的产品清单、尺寸、数量、物料清单（BOM）或技术图纸发送给我们以获取报价。

faqs.a: Bolts, nuts, threaded rods and studs, anchor and foundation fasteners, expansion anchors, self-drilling and self-tapping screws, pins, rivets and retaining components, solar / PV fasteners, and custom non-standard fasteners.
faqs.a_zh: 螺栓、螺母、螺纹杆及螺柱、地脚与基础紧固件、膨胀锚栓、自钻及自攻螺钉、销/铆钉及挡圈组件、光伏紧固件，以及定制非标紧固件。

faqs.a: Hex bolts in grade 4.8 are listed from M6 to M24, high-strength hex bolts from M8 to M30, flange bolts from M6 to M16, countersunk socket screws from M4 to M24 and tension control bolts from M16 to M24. Custom large bolts are handled in the M30 to M120 category.
faqs.a_zh: 4.8级六角螺栓规格为M6至M24，高强度六角螺栓为M8至M30，法兰螺栓为M6至M16，内六角沉头螺钉为M4至M24，扭剪型高强度螺栓为M16至M24。定制大规格螺栓则在M30至M120范围内处理。

faqs.q_zh: 你们是否供应高强度螺栓？
faqs.a: Yes. Grades 8.8, 10.9 and 12.9 are listed for high-strength hex bolts and socket head cap screws.
faqs.a_zh: 是的。高强度六角螺栓及内六角圆柱头螺钉提供8.8、10.9和12.9级。

faqs.q_zh: 你们是否提供大直径螺栓？
faqs.a: Yes. Custom bolts are handled in an M30 to M120 category. Length, grade, material and finish are confirmed case by case against your drawing.
faqs.a_zh: 是的。定制螺栓涵盖M30至M120范围，长度、强度等级、材质及表面处理将根据您的图纸逐案确认。

faqs.q_zh: 你们能生产非标紧固件吗？
faqs.a: Yes. Drawing-based custom components, special geometries, oversized and extra-long parts are reviewed against your technical documentation.
faqs.a_zh: 是的。来图定制零件、特殊形状、超大规格及超长零件均可根据您的技术文件进行评审。

faqs.q_zh: 你们是否生产反牙（左旋）产品？
faqs.a: Reverse-thread (left-hand) screws and trapezoidal threaded rods are part of the custom portfolio.
faqs.a_zh: 反牙（左旋）螺钉及梯形螺纹杆均属于定制产品系列。

faqs.q_zh: 你们是否供应光伏紧固件？
faqs.a: Yes — PV bolts and nuts, pressure-block bolts, support brace rods, seismic support accessories, C-channel matching bolts, clamps, triangle connectors and tile hooks.
faqs.a_zh: 是的——包括光伏专用螺栓螺母、压块螺栓、支撑拉杆、抗震支架配件、C型钢配套螺栓、压块、三角连接件及瓦钩。

faqs.a: Add products to your RFQ list and submit it, or send your product list directly through the Request Center.
faqs.a_zh: 将产品添加至询价清单并提交，或通过需求中心直接发送您的产品清单。

faqs.a: Yes. XLS, XLSX, CSV and PDF purchasing lists can be submitted instead of entering each item manually.
faqs.a_zh: 是的。可提交XLS、XLSX、CSV或PDF格式的采购清单，无需逐项手动录入。

faqs.a: Yes. PDF, DWG, DXF, STEP/STP, JPG, PNG and XLSX files can be submitted with a custom fastener request.
faqs.a_zh: 是的。可随定制紧固件需求一并提交PDF、DWG、DXF、STEP/STP、JPG、PNG及XLSX格式文件。

faqs.q_zh: 你们是否与经销商合作？
faqs.a: Yes. Distributor and importer cooperation is handled through the distributor application.
faqs.a_zh: 是的。经销商及进口商合作请通过经销商申请渠道办理。

faqs.q: What information should I provide for an RFQ?
faqs.q_zh: 提交询价时需要提供哪些信息？
faqs.a: Product type, diameter, length, thread, grade, material, surface treatment, standard or drawing, and quantity. Provide what you have — missing details are clarified during technical review.
faqs.a_zh: 产品类型、直径、长度、螺纹、强度等级、材质、表面处理、执行标准或图纸以及数量。请提供您已有的信息——缺失的细节将在技术评审阶段进一步确认。
